show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Laksh Malhotra, an undercover army hero, returns home to find his father’s legacy ruined by corruption. To uncover the truth, he deliberately gets arrested and enters Dharamveer Correctional Jail as Qaidi Number 17. Inside, he faces torture, betrayal, and deadly guards while secretly collecting proof. With help from allies, he exposes the corrupt system and restores justice. Watch now.
